validity.researcher_notes: Real, correctly classified transmission trunk: BTG (operator) lists the three-string DN1220 'Торжок — Минск — Ивацевичи' among Belarus transit gas mains; BTG history: string I completed 1974-10-26 (453 km), string II in operation 1978, string III 1983 (this row = string II, in service 1978). Spec flags, per ResearcherNotes the 40 bcm/y is the corridor total carried on each of P3483/P5654/P5655 (aggregate-vs-segment; DN1220 string is ~15-20 bcm/y class) and length 851 km is unsourced here: BTG/bstu.by give 453 km for the string/Belarus leg. Not overwritten. Duplicate note: the three rows are strings of one corridor, not duplicates. P3483 also carries ConstructionYear 1971, which no source supports (1974 first completion). Operator is BTG for the Belarus section; the Russian section (Torzhok hub) belongs to Gazprom Transgaz Saint Petersburg. Start/End states blank (vocab note).
